title: What an equilibrium needs
text: An equilibrium is a constant $$y=c$$ that makes $$y'=0$$ for every $$x$$.

title: Test a constant
text: If $$y=c$$, then we would need $$0=c-x$$ for every value of $$x$$ and that cannot happen, since $$c-x$$ changes as $$x$$ changes. So there is no equilibrium solution.
